description:
## Summary

The conversation focused on **decomposing a monolithic `CODXJuniorSession` engine** into logical sub-modules. The analysis identified **10 specialized modules** including File, Knowledge, Code Generation, Chat, Git, Wiki, Mentions, Project, Patch, and Media operations. Each sub-module was implemented as a dedicated manager class (`FileManager`, `CodeGenerator`, `GitManager`, `WikiOperations`, `MentionOperations`) with clear responsibilities and docstrings. The original `CODXJuniorSession` was refactored into a **thin orchestrator** using the composition pattern, delegating all operations to the appropriate sub-module managers. All new files were placed under organized subdirectories (e.g., `codx/junior/file/`, `codx/junior/git/`, `codx/junior/wiki/`) following Python package conventions.
